pairs.subject: mcp-tools
pairs.evidence: crates/table-core/src/agent.rs:136 AgentTool is identified only by its addressable MCP name (name() and serde snake_case give the same string), and the wallet's audit trail persists that name per refusal and withheld call, so renaming a tool would split its recorded history into a death and a birth.

techniques.evidence: crates/table-core/src/agent.rs:136 No rename-stable id beside the name. The technique's 'single server, handful of tools' carve-out does not apply, because table-app's audit (intent.refused / mcp.withheld) stores the tool name over time.
crates/table-core/src/agent.rs:6 The agent projection is closed by type: no free String, so counterparty text cannot reach the model through table_view.
crates/table-core/src/agent.rs:406 The agent surface is a strict subset held by subtraction: money tools such as capture do not exist for agent roles, while the owner keeps them.
crates/table-core/src/agent.rs:507 Refusals are a closed code set, each with a fixed in-band sentence the model can act on. Tool names are verb_object.
crates/table-core/src/agent.rs:323 The per-turn allowed list and the dispatch refusal come from one function, so listed and callable cannot drift.
crates/table-core/src/agent.rs:410 Tools act on the deal the run was minted for (OutOfScope otherwise), not on whatever the desktop UI has selected.
